summary: Iteration 7: (1) Backend regression via pytest (7/7 pass): admin login, /api/auth/me, GET/PUT /api/automation/config persistence (boost_enabled toggle + protect_min_coins change persisted after reload, then restored), auth-required check, notifications & status endpoints. (2) Mobile (390x844) sidebar drawer live test: sidebar off-canvas by default (x=-256), content full width, hamburger visible, drawer slides in with all 6 nav links + admin link, overlay click closes, nav link navigates AND auto-closes drawer. One defect: the hamburger/X button is NOT clickable while the drawer is open because the overlay (z-40) intercepts pointer events over the fixed top bar (also z-40). (3) Desktop (1920x900) regression: sidebar always visible, no hamburger, all 7 nav pages open, Configuration renders 'Filter Chat & Boost', 'Proteksi Ikan Langka', 'Grup & Verifikasi', Simpan works, zero console/error elements. (4) Code review of extract/sell ordering: order is CORRECT.

minor.issue: Early-return when rarity_summary_pattern is absent on page 1 returns 0 BEFORE scanning any page for coins >= protect_min_coins, so high-value non-rare fish are never protected in that case.
Still sends /favorite one number per command (line ~1163) instead of the grouped '/favorite 5 56 110' format used by _protect_rare_fish; inconsistent and slower.

ui_bugs.issue: When the drawer is open, the X/hamburger toggle cannot be clicked: overlay div (md:hidden fixed inset-0 z-40) is rendered after the top bar (also z-40) and intercepts pointer events (Playwright: 'mobile-overlay intercepts pointer events', click timeout). User can only close via overlay tap or nav link. Fix: give top bar z-50 (and overlay z-30/z-40 below it), or render overlay before top bar with lower z-index.

action_items: Raise mobile top bar z-index above the overlay so the X toggle closes the drawer (currently blocked by overlay).
Optional: in _protect_rare_fish, do not early-return on missing rarity summary when protect_min_coins > 0 (scan pages for valuable fish too).
Optional: make _inventory_favorite use the grouped /favorite command format.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: _extract_and_sell() order is STEP 1 self._protect_rare_fish(cfg, chat) (wrapped in try/except) -> STEP 2 extract flow (/extract + Inventory button + 🟢 SEMUA ARTEFAK + confirm) -> STEP 3 self._do_sell(cfg, chat, protected=True) which sends cfg.sell_command (/jual semua) and skips protection because of the protected flag.

VERIFIED: _protect_rare_fish paginates /inventory (max cfg.inventory_max_pages, dedup by page number), accumulates positions across ALL pages, then sends grouped commands: cfg.favorite_command_template.replace('{n}', ' '.join(nums)) chunked at 20 per command -> yields '/favorite 5 56 110' style, not one-by-one.

VERIFIED: _do_sell recursion at line 1090 (mancing retry) passes protected=protected; the gift-cancel recursion at line 1112 passes retry_after_favorite=True which the guard `if not protected and not retry_after_favorite` also treats as already-protected, so protection never re-runs in the extract+sell path.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (mobile drawer works; X-toggle close blocked by overlay)

rca_of_the_issue: Mobile close-via-toggle failure: in DashboardLayout.jsx the top bar (line 53) and the overlay (line 75) both use z-40; since the overlay appears later in the DOM it paints on top and swallows pointer events over the toggle button, so the X button is unclickable while open.
